mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity and economic momentum, which directly supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days. This relationship holds consistently across all economic regimes without requiring a specific threshold condition.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases the cost of capital and compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days. This effect is amplified when inflation remains elevated.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 45% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 0.5% in the prior month indicates strong consumer demand and economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through a multiplicative effect on corporate revenue expectations.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both rise >0.5% in prior month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS rise >0.5% in the prior month, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (defined by UNRATE below 3.5%), a further decline in the unemployment rate signals labor market tightness that may trigger inflationary pressures and subsequent monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 45% of instances during late-cycle expansions (UNRATE < 3.5%), or the Rank IC for UNRATE in this regime is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of retail sales (RSAFS) reflects robust consumer spending and economic activity, which directly supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This relationship is consistent across all economic regimes without requiring a specific threshold condition.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) below 1200 thousand units indicate a contracting housing sector and weak consumer confidence, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days. This threshold condition is specific to housing market weakness.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 45% of instances when HOUST is below 1200, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) combined with elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year) indicates a persistent inflationary environment that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through a multiplicative effect on risk premiums.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 45% of instances when both FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained regime (defined by INDPRO below its 12-month moving average), a low level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates economic weakness and reduced corporate output capacity, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 45% of instances during supply-constrained regimes (INDPRO < 12-month MA), or the Rank IC for INDPRO in this regime is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
